newsitem.title: UK: Guinness up after Seagrams Q2 improves.
newsitem.headline: Guinness up after Seagrams Q2 improves.

text.p: Shares in Guinness rose against a broadly weaker market after stronger second quarter profits from Canada's Seagrams raised hopes that the spirits sector is due for a bounce, traders said.
Guinness' shares climbed 8p to 477-1/2p by 0924 GMT.
Seagram yesterday said its net profit rose to $62 million in the two month period ended June 30 from $58 million in the year ago period, despite a weak performance in its entertainment units.
ABN AMRO Hoare Govett this morning made positive comments on Guiness, as well as Allied Domecq, this morning on the basis of Seagram's results, traders said.
"The outlook for spirits looks a bit brighter after those (Seagram) figures," said one market maker.
